svg.title: Locations of445 archived REDSOX current profiles in2001
svg.desc: Overview and near-field position detail for222 winter and223 summer profiles. Circles/triangles denote winter navigation/bottom reference; squares/diamonds denote summer navigation/bottom reference. The archive includes transit and far-field positions; not every point is a descending Red Sea plume. A dashed rectangle identifies the detail window, not a current extent. There are310 quantity-count conflicts and15 unclear reference headers. Current widths remain unknown. Complete coordinates, source times and per-profile issues appear in the companion JSON and plan.
